subject.title: Dashboard: preview widget — live URL embed, dev-server preview, browser-backed inspection

question: Should OpenClaw accept a trusted builtin dashboard preview widget that can embed external URLs now and later own dev-server/browser-inspection capabilities?
rationale: The feature is useful but deliberately grants a first-party dashboard widget capabilities that sandboxed custom widgets should not have, so maintainer security and product intent must be explicit before merge.

options.title: Review the open phase-1 PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101354 as the concrete place to accept or revise the trusted embed, reload, and viewport boundary.

options.title: Keep roadmap-only for now
options.body: Leave this issue open until the dashboard substrate and trusted-widget SDK direction are accepted.

options.title: Reject bundled preview
options.body: Ask for a plugin or SDK-gap proposal instead if maintainers do not want this capability bundled as a trusted builtin.

recommendation.title: Review the open phase-1 PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101354 as the concrete place to accept or revise the trusted embed, reload, and viewport boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the current bundled plugin-tab seam that would host this feature, making them the best code-path routing owner from current-main history.
